name: BW723C86
summary: BW-723C86 is a tryptamine derivative drug which acts as a 5-HT2B receptor agonist. It has anxiolytic effects in animal studies, and is also used for investigating the function of the 5-HT2B receptor in a range of other tissues.

pharmacology.text: BW-723C86 is a tryptamine derivative drug which acts as a 5-HT2B receptor agonist. It has anxiolytic effects in animal studies, and is also used for investigating the function of the 5-HT2B receptor in a range of other tissues. Highly selective 5-HT2C antagonists are available however, and so a combination of BW-723C86 with a selective 5-HT2C antagonist allows 5-HT2B mediated responses to be studied in isolation.

summaryZh: BW-723C86是一種人工合成的帶有噻吩官能團的色胺衍生物，分子式C16H18N2OS，可作為5-HT2B受體激動劑，在動物實驗中顯示出有抗焦慮藥作用並對在一些其它組織中5-HT2B受體的功能進行了研究。
summaryZhHans: BW-723C86是一种人工合成的带有噻吩官能团的色胺衍生物，分子式C16H18N2OS，可作为5-HT2B受体激动剂，在动物实验中显示出有抗焦虑药作用并对在一些其它组织中5-HT2B受体的功能进行了研究。

fact.en: It is a tryptamine built to switch on only the 5-HT2B receptor, the one found in heart valves. That receptor is why some diet drugs and ergot medicines damaged hearts, so a selective tool for it was valuable.
fact.zh: 它是一種色胺，設計上只活化 5-HT2B 受體，也就是存在於心臟瓣膜上的那個受體。某些減肥藥與麥角類藥物之所以損害心臟，正是因為這個受體，因此針對它的選擇性工具相當有價值。
fact.zhHans: 它是一种色胺，设计上只活化 5-HT2B 受体，也就是存在于心脏瓣膜上的那个受体。某些减肥药与麦角类药物之所以损害心脏，正是因为这个受体，因此针对它的选择性工具相当有价值。
